# Lyle's Lens Photography

> Sports photography and photo libraries for Canberra's sporting organisations. Lyle Holt photographs portraits and headshots, games and events from the ground and the air, and audits and organises the photographs an organisation already owns. Based in Canberra, ACT, Australia. Prices are published on each page below.

Lyle's Lens starts with what your organisation needs to show, then plans the photography around it. The result is a reusable photo library built around your athletes, your programme and your organisation. Lyle Holt runs it from Canberra. The work is organised in three areas: Identity (portraits and headshots), Action (games and events, including drone work) and Evidence (photo library audits and setup). Enquiries go by email to lyle.holt@lyleslens.com.

## Services and prices

- [Portraits and headshots (Identity)](https://lyleslens.com/portraits/): studio-lit headshots and portraits at your workplace, club or training ground, for athletes, executives and whole teams. Headshot package $550, Profile package $950, Identity package $1,600; teams and groups up to 10 people $1,850, then $90 per extra person.
- [Sports and event photography (Action)](https://lyleslens.com/sports-photography-canberra/): game and event coverage from the ground and the air. Coverage from $550 for up to two hours, $1,000 half day, $1,850 full day; aerial from $275 an hour (CASA ReOC and RePL); photographs from a game from $15.
- [Photo library audit and organisation (Evidence)](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/): a Discovery Audit ($1,200, credited against any work that follows) reviews the photographs an organisation already owns against six jobs, then the library is set up and filled. Setup is quoted after the audit.

## Case records

- [Hockey ACT: a photo library built over three seasons](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/hockey-act-athlete-identity/): photographs used in Hockey ACT's selection announcements, programme promotion and Strategic Plan.
- [AFL Canberra season media day](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/afl-canberra-media-day/): about 70 players and umpires from six clubs, around 200 portraits on white in one day.
- [American Football ACT flag football](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/act-gridiron-flag-football/): four months of photographs made for recruiting players and growing the community.
- [Dr Anthony Walker, Optimised Human Performance](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/walker-ohp/): one portrait shoot built into a library for LinkedIn, a company website, speaking and the media.
- [100 Squadron RAAF: Warbirds Over Scone](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/100sqn-warbirds-scone/): portrait and documentary coverage of heritage flight operations.
- [Cross-sector work](https://lyleslens.com/evidence/cross-sector-deployment/): the same approach outside sport: a board portrait shoot for a company director, and athletics at a US Department of Defense school in Tokyo.

## About

- [About Lyle Holt](https://lyleslens.com/about/): 34 years in the Royal Australian Navy and Air Force, recognition and professional standards.
- [Why women's sport](https://lyleslens.com/why-womens-sport/): why the practice builds photo libraries around women's pathway athletes.
